:= by
  have h2 : p = 1/2 ∨ p < 1/2 ∨ p > 1/2 := eq_or_lt_or_gt p (1/2)
  obtain ⟨h21, h22, h23⟩ := h2
  by_cases h21: p = 1/2
  { rw h21 at h0 h1
    simp only [h21, mul_one, one_sub]
    exact le_rfl }
  by_cases h22: p < 1/2
  { have h4 : 0 ≤ 1/2 := by norm_num
    have h5 : 1/2 ≤ 1 := by norm_num
    have h6 : p ≤ 1/2 := h22
    have h7 : 0 ≤ p := h0
    have h8 : p * (1 - p) ≤ (1/2) * (1 - p) := mul_le_mul' h0 h7 (le_sub_iff_add_le.2 h6) (le_sub_iff_add_le.2 h5)
    have h9 : (1/2) * (1 - p) ≤ 1/4 := by
      have h10 : 1 - p ≥ 1 - 1/2 := sub_le_sub_right_iff.1 h6
      rw [mul_one] at h10
      have h11 : 1 - p ≥ 1/2 := h10
      have h12 : (1/2) * (1 - p) ≤ (1/2) * (1/2) := mul_le_mul_left h11 (le_refl (1/2))
      exact h12
    exact h8.trans h9 }
  by_cases h23: p > 1/2
  { have h4 : 0 ≤ 1/2 := by norm_num
    have h5 : 1/2 ≤ 1 := by norm_num
    have h6 : 1/2 ≤ p := h23
    have h7 : 0 ≤ p := h0
    have h8 : p * (1 - p) ≤ p * (1 - 1/2) := mul_le_mul' h7 h0 (le_sub_iff_add_le.1 h6) (le_sub_iff_add_le.1 h5)
    have h9 : p * (1 - 1/2) ≤ (1/2) * (1 - 1/2) := by
      have h10 : p ≤ 1 := h1
      have h11 : p ≤ 1/2 := le_trans h6 h5
      have h12 : p ≤ 1/2 := h11
      have h13 : p ≤ 1/2 := h12
      have h14 : (1 - 1/2) = 1/2 := by norm_num
      have h15 : p * (1 - 1/2) ≤ (1/2) * (1 - 1/2) := mul_le_mul_left h13 h14
      exact h15
    exact h8.trans h9 }
  exact h3
